title: Transcription shapes DNA replication initiation to preserve genome integrity
boundary: Sequential EdU then BrdU incorporation is followed by click-biotin labeling/fragmentation, anti-BrdU purification and streptavidin recovery from the retained supernatant. Two physically separated nascent-DNA label populations distinguish initiation from elongation. Different selection/partition boundary from single-pulse scEdU-seq, E/L Repli-seq sorting or eSPAN protein-associated nascent DNA; not proposed simply for another cell-cycle time point.

title: UdgX-Mediated Uracil Sequencing at Single-Nucleotide Resolution
boundary: Biotin-tagged UdgX forms covalent uracil-DNA complexes after adapter ligation and denaturation; streptavidin capture and polymerase stalling recover lesion-adjoining extension products for a second adapter. Covalent sensor capture plus stop-defined readout differs from Excision-seq cleavage or AP-seq chemical abasic labeling, rather than merely replacing a lesion-excision enzyme.
evidence_scope: PublishedJanuary2022 primary ACS identity/abstract and Results Fig1 workflow paragraphs read. Original full page and publishedSI links are available from publisher; detailed SI not inspected. No correction/version/linked-source audit or source-bundle acquisition.

title: High-resolution Digital Mapping of N-Methylpurines in Human Cells Reveals Modulation of Their Induction and Repair by Nearest-neighbor Nucleotides
boundary: Restriction-defined genomic fragments are cleaved at methylpurine lesions and strand-specifically recovered with biotin capture oligos that also complement an adapter. Lesion-adjoining ssDNA receives barcoded RC-Ai/P1 adapters for Ion Torrent readout. Targeted hybrid capture plus this end-adapter arrangement differs from genome-wide AP-seq/CPD-seq and generic hybrid enrichment, not just another damage target.

title: Genome-wide single-cell and single-molecule footprinting of transcription factors with deaminase
boundary: Tn5 tagmentation in permeabilized cells precedes dsDNA cytidine deamination, enriching accessible fragments before copyable protein-footprint marking. Single-cell branches use cytosine-depleted indexed Tn5 oligos and subsequent cell-index PCR. This order and protected adapter/index preparation differ from queued DAF-seq whole-fiber deamination/PTA; bulk and single-cell FOODIE stay one candidate, not another deaminase-only variant.

title: Calling Cards enable multiplexed identification of the genomic targets of DNA-binding proteins
boundary: TF-Sir4 recruitment of Ty5 integrase deposits barcoded genomic transposons near protein-binding sites; restriction/circularization/inverse PCR recovers transposon-genome junctions and TF identity for paired-end sequencing. Permanent targeted genomic insertion creates a recording substrate unlike snapshot ChIP/ATAC or methylase marking. Later self-reporting RNA Calling Cards and software are not additional candidates here.
evidence_scope: Published2011 primary PMC3083092 identity/abstract/introduction and Calling-Card-seq multiplexing overview read; source GAII genomic junction/barcode readout explicit. title: Dynamic landscape of protein occupancy across the Escherichia coli chromosome
boundary: Formaldehyde-crosslinked and heavily digested protein-bound DNA is retained at the phenol-chloroform INTERFACE for sequencing, with a separate RNAP ChIP arm. Different physical fraction from aqueous unbound-DNA FAIRE and from endogenous DPC KCl-SDS precipitation. RNAP signal adjustment is computational, not a physical depletion; bacterial species and regulatory targets stay branches.
